description: Start learning from a public account: pass its @handle or profile link. Nothing is ever done to their account; only their public posts are recorded. Adding one that's already there returns it. A new Instagram, YouTube, Bluesky or Mastodon competitor is refreshed on the server right away (refresh_queued); for a network that doesn't share other accounts' posts, refresh_error says so plainly.

account_id.description: Your account to compare it with; defaults to your only account on that network

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

platform.description: Needed only for a bare handle when the workspace has accounts on more than one network

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: competitor_add
title: Add a competitor
